title: Interactive Slice KPI Tiles
summary: Filter a queue by branch, then use a metric to inspect the requests behind its count.
interactionSpecs: Branch changes recalculate all four counts.
Select a tile to filter the queue. Select it again to clear.
Positive breach counts use alarm styling. A zero count stays neutral.
codeLivewirePhp:
<?php
namespace App\Livewire;

use Illuminate\View\View;
use Livewire\Component;

class SliceKpiTiles extends Component
{
    private const NAMES = ['Active', 'Breached', 'Closing <2h', 'Unassigned'];
    private const ROWS = [
        ['ref' => 1042, 'title' => 'VPN drops every 10 minutes', 'branch' => 'North Hub', 'status' => 'In Progress', 'minutes' => -30, 'unassigned' => false],
        ['ref' => 1043, 'title' => 'Printer on floor 2 shows paper jam', 'branch' => 'Harbor Office', 'status' => 'Open', 'minutes' => 75, 'unassigned' => true],
        ['ref' => 1044, 'title' => 'New starter laptop setup', 'branch' => 'Central Campus', 'status' => 'Scheduled', 'minutes' => 240, 'unassigned' => false],
        ['ref' => 1046, 'title' => 'Meeting room display not detected', 'branch' => 'Harbor Office', 'status' => 'Open', 'minutes' => 405, 'unassigned' => true],
        ['ref' => 1047, 'title' => 'Email signature template update', 'branch' => 'Central Campus', 'status' => 'Resolved', 'minutes' => 60, 'unassigned' => false],
    ];
    public string $branch = '';
    public string $selected = '';

    public function toggle(string $name): void
    {
        abort_unless(in_array($name, self::NAMES, true), 422);
        $this->selected = $this->selected === $name ? '' : $name;
    }

    private function matches(array $row, string $name): bool
    {
        if (in_array($row['status'], ['Resolved', 'Closed'], true)) {
            return false;
        }
        return match ($name) {
            'Active' => true,
            'Breached' => $row['minutes'] < 0,
            'Closing <2h' => $row['minutes'] >= 0 && $row['minutes'] < 120,
            'Unassigned' => $row['unassigned'],
            default => false,
        };
    }

    public function render(): View
    {
        $branches = array_unique(array_column(self::ROWS, 'branch'));
        $scoped = array_filter(self::ROWS, fn ($r) => $this->branch === '' || $r['branch'] === $this->branch);
        $counts = [];
        foreach (self::NAMES as $name) {
            $counts[$name] = count(array_filter($scoped, fn ($r) => $this->matches($r, $name)));
        }
        $visible = array_filter($scoped, fn ($r) => $this->selected === '' || $this->matches($r, $this->selected));
        return view('livewire.slice-kpi-tiles', compact('branches', 'counts', 'visible'));
    }
}
